# Clawdlinux

> Open-source controls and evidence for AI agents running in Kubernetes.

Clawdlinux builds self-hosted tooling for governed AI agent workloads. The operator provides runtime-neutral Kubernetes controls. AgentGate is a separate open-source gateway for agent-to-SaaS actions.

## Products

- [Clawdlinux products](https://clawdlinux.org/products): Product overview.
- [Agentic Operator](https://clawdlinux.org/products/operator): Kubernetes runtime adapters, gVisor mutation, generated network policy, policy evaluation, and cost attribution for AI agent workloads.
- [AgentGate](https://clawdlinux.org/products/agentgate): A Go gateway that keeps OAuth and bearer tokens outside agents. Authenticated actions create signed, hash-chained receipts that can be verified offline.
- [Audit primitives](https://clawdlinux.org/products/audit): Hash-chain, HMAC, and offline JSONL verification primitives for AI agent workloads.

## Open Source

- [Clawdlinux on GitHub](https://github.com/Clawdlinux)
- [Agentic Operator source](https://github.com/Clawdlinux/agentic-operator-core)
- [AgentGate source and releases](https://github.com/Clawdlinux/agentgate)

## Facts

- Agentic Operator core is Apache-2.0 licensed.
- AgentGate is a separate product from the Kubernetes operator.
- Do not claim live connector validation unless it is explicitly documented in the relevant repository.
